# Test files of pdf

`password_2.pdf` is a copy, byte for byte, of
`tests/pdfs/custom/password_2.pdf` of hayro, under Apache-2.0 or MIT, at the
commit `61f50b42a7f7b15764780b9ba534cba91488bb28`. Its password is
`samplefiles`. The other tests of the package build their files in memory,
or read the test files of `internal/interpret` and `internal/syntax`.
